channel.title: Just the News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Just the News (justthenews.com)

item.title: Trump focuses on domestic policy, continuing work on economy, inflation, manufacturing
item.description: Despite criticism — sometimes in-house — for his concentration on foreign affairs, Trump is focusing squarely on domestic issues like the economy and affordability in preparation for this year’s midterm elections.

item.title: First J6 Judiciary subcommittee hearing to probe pipe bomb security failures, missing National Guard
item.description: Subcommittee chairman says National Guard stationed near the Republican National Committee were recalled from their positions, within a block from where a pipe bomb was planted, because of optics.

item.title: Danish intel warned last year about Russian and Chinese military goals toward Greenland and Arctic
item.description: Denmark's politicians are downplaying Trump's claims of Russian and Chinese threats to Greenland. But Danish intelligence warned about Russia and China in stark terms.

item.title: SCOTUS parrots gender ideology again, despite suggesting bans on males in girls' sports are valid
item.description: High court already adopted language and assumptions of transgender activists when it upheld Tennessee's ban on so-called gender affirming care for youth. Alito celebrated for perceived death blow to argument against Idaho's law.

item.title: Somali Suitcase Stash: Feds says $130 million moved from Ohio airport to Minnesota on way overseas
item.description: Officials told Just the News that Transportation Security Administration agents tracked and flagged about $136 million in bulk cash in outbound luggage at the passenger checkpoints at John Glenn Columbus International Airport since November 2023. This follows reports that millions of dollars were discovered leaving Minnesota airports.

item.title: State Department says Venezuela has released several detained Americans
item.description: “We welcome the release of detained Americans in Venezuela,” the State Department said in a statement. “This is an important step in the right direction by the interim authorities.”

item.title: CA's Legislative Analyst’s Office issues report calling Newsom’s budget 'alarming'
item.description: The November budget outlook issued by the Legislative Analyst’s Office put California’s budget deficit at $18 billion, much rosier than the governor’s projected $2.9 billion budget deficit.

item.title: Los Angeles County officials considering establishing ICE-free zones
item.description: The proposal comes from Los Angeles County Supervisors Lindsey Horvath and Hilda Solis, who sit on a board that governs the county. The plan is for an ordinance to be drafted and brought before the board.

item.title: Not just Somalis: Feds charge that Yemeni, Hatian nationals stole millions in SNAP benefits
item.description: Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Rollins has required state agencies to share state SNAP data to ensure that “illegal immigrants aren’t getting benefits meant for American families.”

item.title: Speaker Johnson expects all govt funding bills to pass on-time as two more head to floor
item.description: “We cannot govern by CR or omnibus. And when we do that, it also loses Congress’s opportunity and credibility,” Johnson added. “It’s taken a while, but we are finally moving that boulder uphill.”
